basic_details.short_information: The walk-in interview for Senior Resident posts at Indira Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Patna is on 23 November 2026 (Monday) at 11:00 AM. It will be held in the H.O.D. Chamber, PMR Dept, IGIMS, Patna-14. Reporting starts at 09:00 AM, and no one reporting after 10:30 AM will be accepted. There are 2 posts of Senior Resident (UR – 01, EBC – 01) on an ad-hoc basis for 89 days in the Department of Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation (PMR). The pay is Rs. 67700/- plus NPA and the usual allowances. The walk-in is open to eligible Indian citizens.

how_to_apply: Download the application form (Proforma for the Post of Senior Resident) from the IGIMS website, www.igims.org.

Fill in the form: advertisement number, post and department, name with NMC/State Medical Council registration number, father's name, date of birth with age on the cut-off date, category, addresses, contact number, educational qualifications starting from MBBS, experience after MD/DNB, publications and presentations, employment status, Demand Draft details and the list of enclosures.
Affix a recent photograph and sign the declaration.
Get a Demand Draft for the fee for your category, payable to The Director, IGIMS, Patna.
Bring the form, the Demand Draft, the originals and one set of self-attested copies to the H.O.D. Chamber, PMR Dept, IGIMS, Patna-14 on 23 November 2026, reporting between 09:00 AM and 10:30 AM.
Fill in your name, age, gender, caste, address, educational qualification and the other fields correctly. Once the form is submitted, it cannot be changed.

content_sections.heading: About IGIMS
content_sections.text: Indira Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences (IGIMS), Sheikhpura, Patna-14 describes itself as an autonomous institute of the Government of Bihar, a statutory university created by an Act of the Bihar State Legislature. This recruitment is for its Department of Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation (PMR), under the institute's 89 days Senior Residency Programme.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: There are 2 Senior Resident posts in the Department of PMR: 1 for UR and 1 for EBC. Reservation applies only to candidates with a Bihar State domicile. Applicants from outside Bihar are not entitled to reservation. The notice says the number of vacancies in the department may increase or decrease. It also says that if no eligible female candidate is available (where applicable), a male candidate may be considered for the department. Candidates must hold a medical qualification included in Schedule I & II of the NMC Act. They must also be registered with the Central/State Medical Council. According to the notice, the prescribed qualification is only the minimum requirement and does not by itself make a candidate eligible for the interview. For the discipline-specific eligibility of the post, see the official notification. The upper age limit is 45 (Forty Five) years as on 23 November 2026. Age relaxation follows the State Government rule: The reservation points and the upper age relaxation follow the rules of the Govt. of Bihar. EBC candidates must carry their Caste, Non-Creamy-Layer (NCL) and Domicile Certificates.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is non-refundable and is paid by Demand Draft in favour of The Director, IGIMS, Patna. Payment by any other mode (cash, cheque, money order, postal order, pay order, banker's cheque, postal stamps, etc.) will not be accepted, and such applications will be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Fill in your name, age, gender, caste, address, educational qualification and the other fields correctly. Once the form is submitted, it cannot be changed.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Bring the original and one set of self-attested copies of each of these: Recent passport-size photograph: face clearly visible, in colour, against a light-coloured, preferably white, background. Caps, hats and dark glasses are not acceptable. Religious headwear is allowed but must not cover the face. Demand Draft in original (if applicable) Aadhar Card Date of Birth/SSC/HSSC pass certificate (mentioning date of birth) MBBS degree certificates Internship completion certificates MS/DNB degree/provisional degree certificates Attempt certificate of MBBS and PG degree UG & PG NMC/State registration certificates Category/PwBD certificate (if a seat is claimed in a reserved category) Experience certificate, if any NOC from present employer (for those working in a Govt./Pvt. organisation) Any other relevant documents (research work, publications, etc.) The application form also asks for the following: SC/ST candidates: Domicile and Caste Certificates issued by the Circle Officer of their district/circle. EBC (MBC) and BC candidates: Domicile and Caste Certificates issued by the Circle Officer, with exemption of creamy layer. EWS candidates: Domicile and EWS Certificates issued by the Circle Officer. Reprints of publications and copies of presentation certificates. Candidates who are not employed must give a written statement that they are neither employed in any organisation nor doing any course anywhere.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Reporting and document verification run from 9:00 AM to 10:30 AM on 23 November 2026. Reporting after 10:30 AM will not be accepted. The interview begins at 11:00 AM. The Selection Committee of the Institute will select the candidate(s) based on bio-data and the interview. Candidates must produce all original certificates in proof of the details in their application at the time of the interview. The result will be declared on the IGIMS Patna website, on a date to be notified later.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Appointment
content_sections.text: The pay is as per Institute rule: Rs. 67700/- plus NPA and the usual allowances admissible for a Senior Resident in the Institute. Other allowances on top of pay and NPA are admissible as per rule. Staying on campus is compulsory if accommodation is provided. If accommodation is not provided, HRA is admissible as per rule. The appointment is on an ad-hoc basis for a period of 89 days, until the full-time (3 years tenure) recruitment of Senior Residents is completed through walk-in interview. The post is non-practising. Private practice of any kind, direct or indirect, including laboratory practice, is strictly prohibited and will lead to termination. Selected candidates must submit a legal bond. Under the bond, a candidate who quits or resigns from the Senior Residency programme midway deposits an amount equal to one month's emoluments for every year of the programme not completed.

faq.question: Q1. When is the IGIMS Senior Resident walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The IGIMS Senior Resident (PMR) walk-in interview is on 23 November 2026 (Monday) at 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time and venue for the IGIMS walk-in?
faq.answer: Reporting is from 09:00 AM, and the last reporting time is 10:30 AM on 23 November 2026. The venue is the H.O.D. Chamber, PMR Dept, IGIMS, Patna-14.

faq.question: Q3. How many Senior Resident vacancies are there at IGIMS?
faq.answer: There are 2 Senior Resident posts in the Department of PMR: UR – 01 and EBC – 01. The notice says the number may increase or decrease.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required for IGIMS Senior Resident (PMR)?
faq.answer: The preferred qualification is MD (Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation) / DNB (PMR). If that is not available, MS / DNB (Orthopaedics) or MD / DNB (General Medicine/Paediatrics) is accepted. Registration with the Central/State Medical Council is required.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the IGIMS Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 45 years as on 23 November 2026. SC/ST candidates get 5 years of relaxation, EBC/BC candidates 3 years and female candidates of all categories 3 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of an IGIMS Senior Resident?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 67700/- plus NPA and the usual allowances admissible for a Senior Resident in the Institute.

faq.question: Q7. Are HRA or other allowances paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes. Other allowances on top of pay and NPA are admissible as per rule. If campus accommodation is not provided, HRA is admissible as per rule.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee for the IGIMS Senior Resident walk-in?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 1000/- for UR/EWS/BC candidates and Rs. 250/- for SC/ST/EBC candidates. It is non-refundable and paid by Demand Draft in favour of The Director, IGIMS, Patna.

faq.question: Q9. How will IGIMS select Senior Residents?
faq.answer: The Selection Committee selects candidates based on bio-data and the interview, using a 100-mark scheme. The minimum qualifying levels are 50 percentile for UR, 45 for BC/EBC/EWS and 40 for SC/ST.

faq.question: Q10. Is the IGIMS Senior Resident post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is on an ad-hoc basis for 89 days, until the full-time (3 years tenure) recruitment of Senior Residents is completed.
